extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and institutional eRA/ASSIST users preparing and submitting applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting NIH (and other PHS) grant applications using the ASSIST system, including account/access prerequisites, authentication, and troubleshooting for eRA/Grants.gov credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-factor authentication required
rubrics_metrics.description: Your account is required to use two-factor authentication to access NIH/eRA systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must set up and use either a Login.gov account or an InCommon Federated account that supports NIH's two-factor authentication standards. See 'Access eRA Modules Via Login.gov' and 'Accessing eRA Modules Via an InCommon Federated Account' for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Login via Login.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to NIH/eRA systems is available via Login.gov and you may be redirected to Login.gov to authenticate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Continue to be redirected to Login.gov. If you encounter problems associating a login.gov account with your eRA account, contact the eRA Service Desk (https://grants.nih.gov/support/index.html) or refer to Login.gov help (https://www.login.gov/help/). See the 'Two-Factor Authentication: Accessing eRA Modules via login.gov' resource for additional steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Login via InCommon Federated account (institutional)
rubrics_metrics.description: You may access eRA modules using an InCommon Federated account, but the institution must support and enable two-factor authentication for your account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your institution does not support two-factor authentication or has not enabled your account, contact your local IT department. If two-factor is not available through your institution, register for and use a Login.gov account instead. For federation help contact The InCommon Federation (help@incommon.org).

rubrics_metrics.name: PIV/CAC login requirement where applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: PIV login is required for some access paths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If PIV login is required, use the 'Login with PIV/CAC' option to authenticate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active Grants.gov and eRA Commons credentials required
rubrics_metrics.description: Active Grants.gov and eRA Commons credentials are required to prepare and submit applications using ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure both sets of credentials are active before initiating an application in ASSIST; unresolved credential issues will prevent preparation/submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: FOA identification required to initiate application
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must identify a Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA) and have its FOA number to initiate an application in ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs are posted in the NIH Guide for Grants & Contracts and/or Grants.gov. The FOA text indicates whether ASSIST can be used for that opportunity. Example FOA number formats: PA-XX-XXX or LITC-ABCD-XX-000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invalid credentials and account lockout handling
rubrics_metrics.description: If you enter invalid eRA credentials the account may be locked or rejected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the account is locked, contact your organization's account administrator for assistance or use the 'forgot password/unlock account' link after 15 minutes. If credentials are invalid, contact your organization's account administrator. For persistent login issues, reset your password, delete temporary internet files and cookies, close all browser windows and open a new browser window, and if problems continue contact the eRA Service Desk (toll-free: 866-504-9552).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ASSIST to prepare and submit electronically
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST is the Application Submission System & Interface for Submission Tracking used to prepare and submit applications electronically to NIH and other Public Health Service Agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior to using ASSIST, identify the FOA and confirm ASSIST eligibility. Consult the Application Guide and ASSIST User Guide for instructions on preparing and submitting application components.

rubrics_metrics.name: System availability / scheduled maintenance awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST and eRA systems may be unavailable during scheduled maintenance windows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check maintenance schedules and avoid submitting or performing critical actions during announced maintenance periods (example notice: systems unavailable from 7 p.m. ET on May 9 to 8 a.m. ET on May 10). Plan submissions outside maintenance windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized use and monitoring notice
rubrics_metrics.description: You are accessing a U.S. Government information system provided for U.S. Government-authorized use only; use implies consent to monitoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By using the system you acknowledge there is no reasonable expectation of privacy for communications or data on the system and that the government may monitor, intercept, search, seize, disclose or use communications/data for lawful government purposes. Unauthorized or improper use may result in disciplinary, civil, or criminal penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available help and documentation resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and support are available for applicants using ASSIST and eRA systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Application Guide, ASSIST User Guide, Grants.gov, the NIH Guide for Grants & Contracts, and contact the eRA Service Desk (https://grants.nih.gov/support/index.html) for support. Use provided help links for login.gov and federation support as needed.
